### Our Wants, God’s Will
Author: Wendy Pope
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/our-wants-god-s-will-encouragement-for-today-march-14-2016.html
Passage: 2 Kings 20:6a
Points:
- Unexpected suffering and mortal illness naturally cause deep sorrow and prompt desperate pleas to God.
- Hezekiah prayed fervently and wept, asking the Lord for mercy and more time.
- God heard Hezekiah's cry and graciously extended his life by fifteen years.
- Believers must learn to pray aligned with God's will rather than merely focusing on personal wants.
- Even when God does not answer in the way desired, He can be trusted to work for good.

### The Lord Heals Hezekiah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-heals-hezekiah
Passage: 2 Kings 20:1-11
Points:
- Prophetic warnings of impending death were sometimes given to spur people to turn to God in prayer.
- Hezekiah did not despair but boldly brought his desperate situation before the Lord.
- Human prayers and actions serve as genuine means through which God accomplishes His sovereign purposes.
- God demonstrated tender compassion by restoring Hezekiah's health and reassuring him with a miraculous sign.
- Christians should present their needs earnestly to God, resting in His eternal wisdom and mercy.
